audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Focused Resolve as matchup-defining with no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are the tradeGood/tradeBad lines copy-pasted under unrelated titles. report[8].t and report[9].t misgender Karma as 'his'/'him' — she is she/her per champ-gender.js.
audit.why: Karma's Focused Resolve (W tether) is a real 12s cooldown per the kit. Karma's R (Mantra) has no cast cooldown itself but empowers her next spell, so citing the W's cooldown is the concrete, sourced number here rather than inventing one for Mantra.
Level chart is Zyra-favoured all seven rows, matching packet.levelChart and win[N] already agrees with phases[N].side.

Spikes correctly identify level 2 (E-root kill window before Karma's RQ mantra is online), level 6 (Zyra gets a true knockup while Karma's R only empowers a spell), and 1st item/late as sustained plant DPS beating her burst-poke identity. Grounded in real kit.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your R Stranglethorns answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: Karma's Focused Resolve (W) tether is a 12s cooldown — break line of sight or step out of range before it locks the root. Your R Stranglethorns answers exactly one disaster per 110/100/90s cooldown; spend it only on swing moments.

edits.before: Seed, Q the pair, root the answer — the trade was 4v2 and the floor did the arguing.
edits.after: Break her W tether with range or a wall — line of sight kills the root before it locks.

edits.before: Trading gardenless like an honest mage — the plants ARE the champion; the spells are gardening tools.
edits.after: Never eat a full RQ Inner Flame combo unseeded — the Mantra cataclysm alone out-trades bare spells.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.
